nodes.name: AgentOrgModernFamilyRecovery.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit of a five-batch fix to the Agent Org 'Modern Family' recovery work, verifying that root-Coordinator plan bypass, incomplete task-chain creation, task-bypassing messages, premature Reviewer completion, and pause/empty-filter bugs are all resolved, plus a narrow task-graph race condition found and fixed during the audit.
nodes.languageNotes: Written in Chinese; includes acceptance-criteria and ten-layer audit tables plus mermaid flowcharts describing the fixed task-graph creation transaction and end-to-end task lifecycle.

nodes.name: AgentOrgPlannerApproval.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit of Agent Org Planner, approval, and Wake hardening covering transactional fixes for plan approval, request delivery, and automatic-approval flows, confirming no partial-write ('half-written database') states remain across the reviewed layers.
nodes.languageNotes: Written in Chinese; includes acceptance-result and ten-layer audit tables plus a mermaid state/event boundary diagram for the plan-approval-to-task-unlock flow.

nodes.name: AppUpdater.md
nodes.summary: Ten-layer architecture audit of the AppUpdater module (src/scaffold/AppUpdater/) confirming a single lifecycle owner and scheduler for update checks/downloads/installs, default-on automatic updates gated by the general.autoUpdateEnabled setting, and test coverage of throttling, coalescing, and install dedup behavior.

nodes.name: GeminiCliRemoval.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit verifying complete removal of the Gemini CLI integration (detection, OAuth, parsing, proxying, storage) while preserving the separate Gemini API-key provider and documenting the transition to the Antigravity CLI provider.
